item: p1-02 SC-58 (AC-12a, H-12) 오라클 ↔ 역사 발견 집합 양방향 차집합 0
oracle_sql: select distinct on (payload->>'star_system_id', payload->>'mineral_id') payload->>'star_system_id', payload->>'mineral_id', tick, sequence, event_id from domain_events where world_id = '01a0ef96-c9ad-7c5e-8e55-1b2afe94f0a9' and event_type = 'MINERAL_MINED' and (payload->>'quantity_kg')::bigint > 0 order by payload->>'star_system_id', payload->>'mineral_id', tick, sequence;
